reader.requirement: At --std 85 a relative file's file control entry must accept the Sequential I-O RESERVE clause, RESERVE integer-1 [AREA | AREAS], with integer-1 an unsigned nonzero integer literal (§1985:III.2), and allocate integer-1 input-output areas (§1985:VII.2.9.3 GR1); any other operand form (zero, signed, decimal, data-name, the 1974 NO/ALTERNATE forms) must be refused. The witnesses are sequential-file only; the relative-file range is covered by this slice's probes.

edition-consulted.switches: IntegerSlot.At(dialectLevel): a zero-permitting slot below its Since edition becomes nonzero; RESERVE is a plain Nonzero row, so the result is the same at every edition
the zero-refusal message cites §1985:III.2 below 2002, §2023:5.5 1) from 2002; same COBOL2386 error either way

ConstructRegistry.IsAvailable(ConstantEntry2002): at 85 a word in the integer-1 position is refused as 'not an integer literal, COBOL-85 has no constant-name'; from 2002 a constant-name is resolved and substituted

reader.edition-search: grep RESERVE/fileReserveClause/ReserveAreas over src/*.cs and the grammar; read the FileControlBinder arm, IntegerOperandPass, ConstantEntryBinder.IntegerOperandValue path, FileControlKeyRules row and the emitter/runtime registration.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: only in the operand class: at 85 the operand must be a literal (no constant-name exists), from 2002 an integer constant-name may stand for integer-1. The clause is otherwise the same at every edition.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses exercise sequential files (l1c24_reserve_clause_forms) and the file-control entry generally; RESERVE on a RELATIVE file and the refusal half are exercised only by this slice's probes

reader.notes: The relative entry takes the same fileReserveClause arm as every organization; integer-1 is screened nonzero by IntegerOperandPass and unsigned/integer by the grammar, and a word in the position is refused at 85 because no constant entry exists there. The area count is registered at run time (RegisterReserve) and has no observable effect beyond acceptance.
